meta.title: FlightMD: drone flight log diagnostics
meta.description: Upload a PX4, ArduPilot or MAVLink telemetry log and get a deterministic diagnostic report: oscillation, vibration, EKF health, battery, GPS, parameters and motors, with the parameter changes to make.
meta.ogDescription: Deterministic drone flight log diagnostics for PX4, ArduPilot and MAVLink.

errorPage.title: Something broke on this page
errorPage.body: The page hit an error while drawing. Your report is not lost: reload, or go back and open it again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address.

unavailable.message: {what} unavailable: the data in this report could not be drawn.

home.hero: Find out why your drone flew badly.
home.intro: Drop a PX4 .ulg, ArduPilot .bin or MAVLink .tlog. About 20 seconds later you get a scored report and the exact parameter changes to make. Deterministic, no account, untagged logs deleted after 1 hour.
home.unsupported: Unsupported file. Upload a PX4 (.ulg), ArduPilot (.bin or .log), MAVLink (.tlog), Betaflight (.bbl) or DJI (.txt, .DAT) log, or one of them in a .gz or .zip.
home.tooLarge: File too large. The limit is {mb} MB.
home.tokenHint: If this is your airframe, paste its access token on the <link>airframe page</link>, then upload again.
home.airframeHelp: Untagged flights expire after 1 hour. A label keeps this flight in that airframe's trend history; the first time you manage a label you get an access token for it.
home.contributeHelp: Saves a copy of the log and its report to FlightMD's open dataset to improve the analysis. No name, account or source is stored. Off by default.

oscillation.name: Oscillation
oscillation.what: control-loop oscillation per axis, with the rate-P change to make

vibration.name: Vibration
vibration.what: IMU RMS and clipping per sensor

ekf.name: EKF health
ekf.what: innovation test ratios and solution flags

home.checksNote: Rockets and balloons also get an ascent & recovery check, and logs with board voltage a power supply check; neither is scored. Checks the log has no data for are marked "Not assessed".
home.briefSummary: Planned in AeroAtlas? Link the planning brief
home.briefHelp: Copy it from the brief in AeroAtlas. The report shows it so the flight can be traced back to its planning evidence.
home.badBrief: The planning brief hash must be 64 hex characters (a SHA-256).

dropzone.prompt: Drop a flight log here, or click to choose one
dropzone.invalidType: {name} is not a flight log this server reads.
dropzone.tooMany: Drop one log at a time.

recent.title: Recent on this device
recent.empty: Logs you analyse in this browser are listed here. Nothing is shared with other visitors.

scoreScale.overall: Overall score, 0–100, weighted across the modules that were assessed
scoreScale.grades: Letter grade: the same score on an A–F scale
scoreScale.weights: Oscillation, vibration and EKF weigh 20 % each; battery and GPS 15 % each; parameters and motors 5 % each. Ascent & Recovery (rockets, balloons) and Power supply are reported but not weighted. A module that could not be assessed is left out of the score and shown as "Not assessed", never as 100.

report.eta: About {eta} left. The page updates itself; you can leave this tab open.
report.usually: Usually about 20 seconds. You can leave this tab open; the page updates itself.
report.expiredBody: Untagged reports are deleted 1 hour after upload. Upload the log again to get a new one.
report.failedDefault: The log could not be analysed.
report.stoppedBody: The analysis has run for over 10 minutes, so this page stopped checking. It may still finish.
report.displayTitle: This report could not be displayed
report.displayBody: The report loaded but part of it could not be drawn. The JSON and PDF exports may still work.
report.interrupted: The server restarted during the analysis. Upload the log again.
report.duplicate: Same log as an earlier upload: this is the report from that upload.

header.assessedFraction: They carry <num>{pct} %</num> of the weighted score.
header.notAssessedNote: Modules the log had no data for are listed as Not assessed below.
header.noneAssessed: None of the checks could run on this log, so there is no score. See flight details for what was missing.
header.parserWarnings: {count, plural, one {# parser warning} other {# parser warnings}}.

findings.title: Findings
findings.none: No findings. Every check that could run on this log passed.
findings.others: {count, plural, one {# other check} other {# other checks}} (info and passed)

params.title: Parameter changes
params.hintQgc: QGroundControl: Parameters → Tools → Load from file. Whole-number values are written as INT32, the rest as REAL32; QGC skips a row whose type doesn't match the vehicle.
params.hintMp: Mission Planner: Config → Full Parameter List → Load from file, then Write Params.
params.applyHelp: Tune, fly, verify: tick the changes you put on the vehicle and mark them applied. The next flight tagged with the same airframe label shows whether they helped.
params.markApplied: {count, plural, =0 {Mark as applied} one {Mark # change as applied} other {Mark # changes as applied}}
params.applied: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} recorded on {label}. The result shows on the <link>airframe page</link> after its next tagged flight.
params.needsToken: Add the airframe's access token on the <link>airframe page</link>, then try again.

charts.evidenceNote: Shaded spans and dashed lines mark when each finding happened, in the finding's severity colour.

details.title: Flight details
details.parserWarnings: {count, plural, one {# parser warning} other {# parser warnings}}: parts of the log that were skipped or repaired

path.title: Flight path
path.noGps: No GPS positions in this log, so there is no path to draw.
path.orbitHint: Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom. Height ×3.

qa.title: Search this report
qa.scope: Answers come only from this report: its findings, module scores and metrics.
qa.scopeAI: The AI is told to answer from this report only; check its answer against the findings.
qa.noProvider: No AI provider is configured on this server
qa.aiUnavailable: This server has no AI provider configured, so questions use the built-in search. That is expected without an API key.
qa.empty: Ask about a check, a parameter, or a word from the findings.
qa.aiAnswer: AI answer, from this report only
qa.placeholderAI: e.g. why did the GPS finding fire?

answer.params: {count, plural, =0 {The report suggests no parameter changes.} one {The report suggests # parameter change.} other {The report suggests # parameter changes.}}
answer.module: {label}: module score {score}, {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}}.
answer.moduleClean: {label}: no finding in this category; module score {score}.
answer.nothing: Nothing in this report mentions "{text}". Try a check name: oscillation, vibration, EKF, battery, GPS, motors, or "parameter changes".

export.title: Export
export.note: The link to this page works for 1 hour unless the flight was tagged with an airframe label.
export.pdfFallback: This server can't render PDFs, so the print dialog opened instead: choose "Save as PDF" there.

compare.title: Flight comparison
compare.mismatch: These flights are from different vehicles or autopilots, so the module scores are not directly comparable.
compare.noDates: The flight date is missing from at least one log, so A and B are in the order you picked them.
compare.metricsNote: Higher is not always better here (HDOP, vibration), so changes are shown without colour.
compare.noneResolvedEarlier: No finding from the earlier flight went away.
compare.noneResolvedA: No finding from flight A went away.
compare.noneNewLater: No new findings in the later flight.
compare.noneNewB: No new findings in flight B.

airframe.noFlights: No flights tagged "{label}" yet. Upload a log with this airframe label to start its trend history; untagged flights expire after an hour.
airframe.modulesNote: Gaps are flights where the module was not assessed.
airframe.metricsNote: The numbers behind each score: a slow drift shows here before a finding fires.
airframe.historyNote: Tick two flights to compare them.

access.unclaimedBody: Claiming the label creates an access token for it. Only someone with the token can read its trend history or change its maintenance log, alerts and webhook. The token is saved in this browser; copy it somewhere safe to use it elsewhere.
access.lockedTitle: This airframe needs its access token
access.lockedBody: "{label}" belongs to whoever claimed it. Paste the token you saved when you claimed it.
access.saved: Access token saved in this browser:

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.help: When a new flight tagged "{label}" breaks a rule, FlightMD posts a message to this airframe's webhook (Slack and Discord work). Only holders of the airframe token can change it.
alerts.badThreshold: Threshold for "{metric}" is not a number.
alerts.badWebhook: The webhook URL must start with https://
alerts.webhookHelp: Must be https:// and reach a public address.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.due: Due for service: <num>{hours}</num> since last maintenance
maintenance.badInterval: Interval must be a positive number of hours.

changes.title: Applied changes
changes.help: Parameter changes marked as applied from a report's parameter sheet, checked against the next tagged flight: the findings that touch those parameters, and the scores.
changes.empty: No changes marked as applied yet. On a report's parameter sheet, tick the changes you made and mark them applied.
changes.pendingHelp: Fly again with the same airframe label to see whether this helped.
